pairs.failure: The first JavaScript-orchestrated PowerShell probe used unsafe nested quoting and failed before filesystem access.
pairs.recovery: Literal paths and scalar commands replaced the nested expression and completed the intended read-only projection.

pairs.failure: A PowerShell normalized-content hash probe selected an ambiguous Replace or hash overload and earned no verification credit.
pairs.recovery: A byte-explicit normalized-LF implementation recovered the packet hash without repository mutation.

pairs.failure: A combined activation-packet projection truncated before EOF and earned no complete-read credit.
pairs.recovery: Bounded non-overlapping fifty-line windows completed the immutable activation packet through EOF.

pairs.failure: A PowerShell foreach pipeline used an empty pipe element while measuring named skill files and failed before any write.
pairs.recovery: Materializing the collection before formatting recovered the exact skill inventory.

pairs.failure: A combined flashcard and Meta Tool Box reference projection exceeded its output budget and earned no complete-read credit.
pairs.recovery: Each directly applicable reference was reread separately through EOF.

pairs.failure: The first lane-admission object embedded command status in a parenthesized expression and failed PowerShell parsing.
pairs.recovery: Scalar status variables recovered the exact branch, remote, D-drive, and candidate-absence admission facts.

pairs.failure: A second foreach-to-pipeline expression failed while summarizing manifest keys and earned no manifest credit.
pairs.recovery: A materialized result collection recovered the manifest structure without replaying Elaren tests or canonical validation.

pairs.failure: A manifest replay launched hundreds of separate Git show processes and returned no attributable result in the bounded window.
pairs.recovery: One read-only Git cat-file batch stream per immutable commit replayed all five manifest and seal sets with zero mismatch.

pairs.failure: A broad source Git grep for candidate-domain words outlived its bounded result window and was terminated without a repository write.
pairs.recovery: The phase semantic auditor replaced the broad grep with source-bounded proposal JSON traversal and exact neighbor quarantine.

pairs.failure: The first no-checkout worktree command exceeded its bounded window after creating only the exact branch while its checkout child continued asynchronously.
pairs.recovery: Read-only state probes found the exact branch and later the exact worktree metadata; no second branch was created and no deletion occurred.

pairs.failure: A resumed worktree-add attempt encountered the path created by the still-running first process and failed closed.
pairs.recovery: The existing exact path and Git metadata were adopted without replacement, reset, or branch rewrite.

pairs.failure: A checkout attempt met the active first process index lock and performed no materialization.
pairs.recovery: After proving the exact owning Git processes and waiting for their natural completion, the lock cleared and sparse state resolved cleanly with two tracked files materialized.

pairs.failure: The first source-bounded semantic audit quarantined ten titles at or above the 0.75 token-Jaccard ceiling, including two exact inherited collisions, and wrote no x1 artifact.
pairs.recovery: Only the ten quarantined titles were rewritten; the other fifty proposals and immutable source stayed unchanged before the isolated semantic dependency was rerun.

pairs.failure: A post-build stale-label scan passed a wildcard filename segment as a literal Windows path and returned an invalid-path error after partially scanning owner artifacts; it earned no complete scan credit.
pairs.recovery: A bounded rg scan used literal owner directories with glob filters, completed the intended source, test, and script check, and changed no repository file.
